text: so just curious because i cant just type in a route where am i going to look for anything
resolution: Answered the navigation question: the Studio is reached without typing a route. In the hmsc-int chrome top nav, the 'Shapes' icon (tooltip 'assets (workbench)') opens /workbench; in the workbench left icon gutter the new Box icon (kicker STUDIO, between Paint and Items) selects the source and renders the viewport in column 4. Confirmed model is an 'assets'-family source (familyOfSource) so it is not filtered out, and traced the wiring (index.tsx onWorkbench → nav.push('/workbench'); WorkbenchRoute renders all sources in gutter-1). Offered a more distinctive icon or a one-click shortcut if the Box icon is ambiguous with the separate compiled-world Box in the top nav.
